context: A mom answers her young son's big questions about animals
purpose: Teach: あたりまえ/所詮/異様/つぎ/目当て/頬/かかわり/いのち

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、どうして動物にもいのちがあるの？
lines.en: Hey Mom, why do animals have life too?
lines.style: Curious child asking a big innocent question.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あたりまえだよ。生きてるものはみんな、いのちを持ってるの。
lines.en: Of course. Every living thing has a life of its own.
lines.style: Gentle motherly tone, warm and matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあ、つぎの質問！どうしてライオンはシマウマを食べちゃうの？こわいよ。
lines.en: Then next question! Why do lions eat zebras? It's scary.
lines.style: Excited child, slightly worried but eager to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ライオンのお目当てはごはんなんだよ。意地悪じゃなくて、生きるためなの。
lines.en: The lions are after food, sweetie. It isn't cruelty, it's survival.
lines.style: Patient explaining voice, kind and reassuring to her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも、なんだか異様にむねがぎゅっとする……シマウマさんの家族が泣いちゃうよ。
lines.en: But somehow my chest feels strangely tight… the zebra's family will cry.
lines.style: Soft trembling voice with welling sympathy and confusion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔の優しい気持ち、ママうれしいよ。ほら、頬に涙がついてる。
lines.en: Mom is glad you're so kindhearted, Sho. Look, there's a tear on your cheek.
lines.style: Tender, slightly emotional, gently wiping child's face.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 動物とのかかわりって、所詮むずかしいことなのかな。
lines.en: Maybe getting along with animals is just inherently difficult after all.
lines.style: Thoughtful child trying to sound grown-up and reflective.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: むずかしいけどね。だからこそ、ありがとうって気持ちを忘れちゃいけないんだよ。
lines.en: It is hard. That's exactly why we should never forget to feel grateful.
lines.style: Warm closing tone, teaching a quiet lesson with love.
